exposure: blood flow around the gestational sac
outcome: success of ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage (D&C) treatment of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 51 patients diagnosed with CSP and treated with ultrasound-guided D&C
finding: Cesarean scar thickness was the main risk factor that determined the success of ultrasound-guided D&C for treating CSP, with higher success rates for scars >3 mm thick.
